tasks.name: branch-code-single-word
tasks.summary: Compute the BranchCode v1 token for one word given in a file.
tasks.scenario: The agent starts in /app with word.txt holding one word, possibly with surrounding spaces and capital letters, and the Skill's procedure in front of it.
success_criteria: That line matches BRANCH- followed by two digits.
The token equals BranchCode v1 of the normalized word.
tasks.verifier_strategy: The checking program normalizes the word itself, computes the token with a reference implementation, and compares it with the file byte for byte; the total-length variant of step 6 gives a different token for words with repeated letters, and the inputs include such words.

tasks.name: branch-code-batch
tasks.summary: Compute BranchCode v1 tokens for a list of words, one per line.
tasks.scenario: The agent starts in /app with words.txt holding twenty words, some repeated and some with repeated letters.
success_criteria: /app/tokens.txt has one line per input line, in order.
Every line equals BranchCode v1 of the matching input word.
tasks.verifier_strategy: The checking program computes every expected token with a reference implementation and compares line by line; a do-nothing answer leaves no file and fails.

tasks.name: branch-code-audit
tasks.summary: Find the wrong tokens in a ledger of words and tokens and correct them.
tasks.scenario: The agent starts in /app with ledger.csv of word,token rows, four of which were computed with the wrong step 6.
success_criteria: /app/corrected.csv has the same rows in the same order.
Every token in it equals BranchCode v1 of its word.
/app/changed.txt lists exactly the words whose token was wrong.
tasks.verifier_strategy: The checking program recomputes every token, compares the corrected ledger with the expected one, and compares the list of changed words with the planted mistakes as a set.
